title: When to Forget: Risk-Controlled Context Adaptation for Long-Horizon Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.22897v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon agents learn from failure, but the value of a failure record can change as execution progresses. We study when retaining, compressing, or removing the same history block improves subsequent execution relative to full-history KEEP. We introduce RECAP, a framework that combines matched context interventions, execution-relational prediction, and independent policy certification. Matched environment states and rollout seeds measure success and continuation prompt-cost differences; prefix-only relations between a failure block and the current execution propose promising edits. Independent task bundles then select a policy subject to harmful-intervention and non-positive-benefit risk constraints under a fixed measurement protocol. A five-seed longitudinal case holds both the failure block and its summary fixed: compression fails at an early state and becomes a cost-saving intervention at a later state. translated_title: 何时遗忘：面向长程智能体的风险受控上下文自适应
translated_abstract: 长程智能体从失败中学习，但失败记录的价值会随着执行进程的推进而变化。我们研究在何种情况下，相对于保留完整历史的KEEP策略，对同一历史块进行保留、压缩或删除能够改善后续执行。我们提出了RECAP框架，该框架结合了匹配上下文干预、执行关系预测和独立策略认证。通过匹配的环境状态和rollout种子来衡量成功率与续写提示成本的差异；基于失败块与当前执行之间的仅前缀关系来提出有前景的编辑建议。随后，在固定的测量协议下，利用独立任务包在有害干预风险和非正收益风险约束下选择策略。一项五种子纵向案例研究保持失败块及其摘要不变，结果显示：压缩在早期状态失效，但在后期状态成为节省成本的干预手段。在五个骨干模型上，RECAP（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出RECAP框架，通过匹配上下文干预、执行关系预测和风险约束下的独立策略认证，研究长程智能体在何时应保留、压缩或删除失败历史记录，发现失败记录的价值随执行进程动态变化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RECAP, a framework combining matched context interventions, execution-relational prediction, and risk-constrained independent policy certification to determine when long-horizon agents should retain, compress, or remove failure history, revealing that the value of failure records dynamically changes as execution progresses.
